pitches.problem: Fragmented affiliate networks make it impossible for early-stage founders to validate demand without significant upfront ad spend.
pitches.solution: Proovd: A decentralized validation protocol where affiliates stake reputation on pre-product startups.
pitches.competition: Kickstarter (Public/High Friction), Gumroad (Post-Product), UserTesting (No Skin in Game).
